title: FerrIL Config
description: Configuration for FerrIL CLR profiler modules (dotpatch, fntrace, asmdump, ssl_unpin). Loaded from the path in COR_PROF_CONFIG_FILE (default: config.json) or inline via COR_PROF_CONFIG_DATA.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference (ignored by the profiler).

patches.description: IL patch definitions for dotpatch / ssl_unpin. Each entry matches a method and replaces its IL body (or a portion of it) at JIT time.

traces.description: Function trace definitions for fntrace / asmdump. Each entry matches a method and captures its arguments and/or return value at call time.

HexByte.description: A single byte as a string. Accepts hex with 0x/\x prefix (e.g. "0x2a", "\x17") or decimal (e.g. "42"). Case-insensitive.

WildcardByte.description: A byte value or wildcard for pattern matching. In addition to HexByte values: '?' or '??' matches exactly one byte, '*' or '**' matches zero or more bytes.

ByteArray.description: An array of IL bytes. Accepts either a JSON array of hex/decimal strings, or a single space-separated string. Wildcards are NOT allowed.

BytePattern.description: An IL byte pattern with wildcards for matching method bodies. Accepts either a JSON array of hex/wildcard strings, or a single space-separated string. '?' matches one byte, '*' matches any run of bytes.

Matcher.description: Function matcher. All specified fields must match (logical AND). At least one of 'name' or 'pattern' is required for validation.

name.description: Method name to match (e.g. "userCertValidationCallbackWrapper", "Load"). Exact match.

class.description: Fully qualified class/type name (e.g. "System.Reflection.Assembly"). Exact match.

pattern.description: IL byte pattern to match against the method body. Supports '?' (one byte) and '*' (any run) wildcards.

OutCfg.description: Output configuration for a traced value (argument or return value).

write_to.description: Where to write the captured data. 'stdout' prints to the log/console; 'file' writes to a dump-XXXX.{txt,bin} file.

metadata.description: If true, include metadata (method signature details) in the output.

TraceParams.description: Configuration for capturing a single function argument.

arg_num.description: 0-based argument index. For instance methods, arg 0 is 'this'; for static methods, arg 0 is the first declared parameter.

write_to.description: Where to write the captured argument data.

metadata.description: If true, include metadata (method signature details) in the output.

PatchDef.description: A single IL patch definition. Combines a Matcher (which method to target) with patch parameters (what to replace). At least 'name' or 'pattern' must be specified.

class.description: Fully qualified class/type name to match.

pattern.description: IL byte pattern to match against the method body.

new_bytes.description: Replacement IL bytes. Defaults to [0x17, 0x2a] (ldc.i4.1; ret — i.e. 'return true').

offset.description: Byte offset within the original method body at which to start the patch. Default 0 (replace from the beginning).

truncate.description: If true, discard all original bytes after the patch. If false, the remaining original bytes are preserved after new_bytes. Default true.

copy_header.description: If true, reuse the original method header (for Fat headers with SEH, locals, etc.). If false, a minimal Tiny header is synthesized. Default false.

TraceDef.description: A single function trace definition. Combines a Matcher (which method to target) with parameters specifying which arguments and/or return value to capture. At least 'name' or 'pattern' must be specified, and at least one entry in 'params' is required.

class.description: Fully qualified class/type name to match.

pattern.description: IL byte pattern to match against the method body.

params.description: List of arguments to capture. At least one is required.

retval.description: If present, capture the method's return value with this output configuration.
